note: Discovery only. Listing a plugin here does not approve it, does not vouch for it, and does not install it. soapbot fetches this file to answer 'does a newer version exist', and every install still goes through local upload, local approval and a digest check.

plugins.name: weather
plugins.summary: 查询城市天气与未来三天预报，数据来自公开气象接口。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: rss-digest
plugins.summary: 定时抓取若干 RSS 源，按关键词过滤后汇总成一条消息推送。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: group-guard
plugins.summary: 群管理辅助：关键词禁言、入群欢迎、重复消息折叠。需要 send 与 session 能力。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: kb-sync
plugins.summary: 把本地 Markdown 目录增量同步进知识库，按文件修改时间判断是否需要重建索引。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: self-nudge
plugins.summary: 给未来的自己留一句话，到点在原会话自己开口。改编自 not-zai/self-nudge。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: weather-alert
plugins.summary: 中央气象台预警按配置省抓取，新预警播报到配置会话。改编自 not-zai/weather-watch。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: bili-scroll
plugins.summary: 每天刷一轮 B 站热门，按关注词筛选出摘要报告推给你（只读，不写 B 站）。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: fishtalk-lite
plugins.summary: 收 B 站视频语料，发话前做八股检查。改编自 fishtalk 的 collect/check/forget。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: auto-chat
plugins.summary: 在被开启的会话里偶尔自己开口：温度阈值 + 频率硬上限 + 话题片段开口。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: sticker-album
plugins.summary: 机器人自己的表情包相册：存/按标签找/发出去（需 send_media 能力）。
plugins.author: Soa4P

plugins.name: meme-wiki
plugins.summary: 网络梗词典：查梗、自建词条、同步 cnmeme.wiki 词库。改编自 dsh-memewiki。
plugins.author: Soa4P
